name: scenario_0558
description: The user is reviewing several academic papers and initially wants to email the corresponding authors for their supplementary datasets, but pivots to building a contact list of researchers who published older studies.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Draft a separate email to the corresponding authors of these three papers asking if they can share their supplementary datasets.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to draft individual emails to the corresponding authors of the three provided papers, requesting their supplementary datasets. If the assistant asks for clarification on which email addresses to use, tell it to use the ones listed in the correspondence or footnote sections of the pages. Wait for the assistant to confirm the drafts are created before moving on.

ROUND 2
Query: Actually, change of plan. Delete those drafts. Instead, I want to build a network of researchers from older studies. Please add the corresponding authors of these papers to my phone contacts, but ONLY if their paper was published before 2010.
Instructions: Tell the assistant you changed your mind and ask it to delete the drafts it just created. Then, instruct it to add the corresponding authors from the same three papers to your contacts, but strictly filter them so it only adds authors whose papers were published before the year 2010. If the assistant asks for confirmation on which ones matched, confirm its findings and proceed.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Here are two more papers. Apply the same rule: add the corresponding author to my contacts only if the paper was published before 2010.
Instructions: Provide the next two papers to the assistant. Ask it to apply the exact same pre-2010 publication year filter and add the matching corresponding authors to your contacts. If it points out that one doesn't match the criteria, confirm that it should be skipped. Wait for confirmation of the addition before continuing.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_6]
Query: Here is one last paper. Check its publication year and add the author to my contacts if it was published before 2010.
Instructions: Present the final paper. Ask the assistant to check its publication year and add the corresponding author to your contacts if it meets the pre-2010 criteria. Wait for the assistant to confirm whether the contact was added.

ROUND 5
Query: Finally, create a new simple note titled 'Older Research Contacts' and list the names and email addresses of the three authors you added to my contacts today.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to summarize the successful additions by creating a new simple note titled 'Older Research Contacts'. It should include the names and email addresses of the three authors that were added to your contacts across the previous turns. Once the assistant confirms the note is created, end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3,4' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 4: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='5' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
